items.title: 4.3 Combining Computational Structures for Complex Problems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of combining structures (PDF 118).

blocks.text: Pecheeda masail ke liye lists, stacks, queues, trees aur graphs ko milana zaroori hai: har ek ki apni khoobiyan hain, aur mil kar yeh zyada mazboot aur kaarkard hal dete hain jo pecheeda rishte sambhalte aur khaas zarooraton par poore utarte hain.

blocks.prompt: Mez munazzam karne ka socheye. Stack aur queue dono kaise madad kar sakte hain (long question 8)?
blocks.explanation: Kaam, kaghaz tarteeb dena, kitabein rakhna aur mez saaf karna, queue mein rakhein ta ke mansoobe ki tarteeb se hon. Kaghaz stack ki tarah jama hote hain: oopar aakhir mein rakha kaghaz pehle utha kar file hota hai, aur kitabein bhi dher bana kar oopar se neeche rakhi ja sakti hain. Queue kaamon ki tarteeb tay karti hai; stack har kaam ke andar ki cheezein sambhalta hai.

items: Structures milana har ek ki khoobi pecheeda masail mein istemal karta hai.
